headline.caveat: ~40% of Stargate LLC; SoftBank's own capital commitment against the $500B/10GW program target is not separately disclosed ($100B committed to deploy 'immediately' at Jan 2025 launch, across all partners)

realized_to_date.caveat: per-partner equity funded to date undisclosed; program-level: >$400B described as in motion across nearly 7GW of sites by late 2025

nature_md: SoftBank is co-lead equity holder (~40%, alongside OpenAI ~40% and Oracle+MGX ~20%) and chairs Stargate LLC — the JV vehicle targeting $500B / 10GW of US AI infrastructure over four years. Masayoshi Son is chairman; SoftBank has 'financial responsibility' while OpenAI has 'operational responsibility.' Beyond LLC equity, SoftBank-side entities develop individual campuses (notably the 10GW Piketon, OH site via its energy subsidiary — the object of the proposed NVIDIA $250B backstop). By Sept 2025 the partners described >$400B of investment in motion over three years across Abilene and five new sites (~7GW); by early 2026 OpenAI put capacity 'well over 8GW.' Per-partner capital contributions have never been broken out — a structural opacity of the whole program.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: JV equity stake carried as an investment (equity method or fair value through SoftBank's Vision Fund structures — treatment not disclosed). Site-level debt lives in project SPVs (e.g., JPMorgan-led loans at Abilene), not on SoftBank's consolidated balance sheet except where its development entities borrow.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Capital contribution to Stargate LLC funding land, shells, power, and long-lead equipment; the LLC layer plus site SPVs keep the buildout's debt off every sponsor's balance sheet individually — the canonical spv_shift structure of the cycle.
